concepts.description: The metabolic process that breaks down glucose to produce ATP, involving glycolysis, the citric acid cycle, and oxidative phosphorylation.
concepts.name: Cellular Respiration

concepts.description: A series of protein complexes on the inner mitochondrial membrane that uses electron carriers to drive oxidative phosphorylation, producing the bulk of ATP.
concepts.name: Electron Transport Chain

concepts.description: The process of ATP synthesis driven by the electron transport chain and chemiosmosis, producing the majority of ATP during cellular respiration.
concepts.name: Oxidative Phosphorylation

concepts.description: The initial stage of cellular respiration where glucose is broken down into pyruvate, ATP, and NADH in the cytoplasm.
concepts.name: Glycolysis

concepts.description: The process by which a proton gradient across the inner mitochondrial membrane drives the synthesis of ATP through ATP synthase during oxidative phosphorylation.
concepts.name: Chemiosmosis

concepts.description: A series of reactions within the mitochondrion that further oxidizes acetyl-CoA, producing additional NADH and FADH2.
concepts.name: Citric Acid Cycle

concepts.description: A three-carbon molecule produced during glycolysis, which enters the mitochondrion to be oxidized to acetyl-CoA.
concepts.name: Pyruvate

concepts.description: An electron carrier molecule produced during glycolysis and the citric acid cycle, essential for providing electrons to the electron transport chain.
concepts.name: NADH

concepts.description: An organelle in eukaryotic cells where pyruvate is oxidized, and the citric acid cycle, electron transport chain, and oxidative phosphorylation occur.
concepts.name: Mitochondrion

concepts.description: A two-carbon molecule formed from the oxidation of pyruvate within the mitochondrion, which then enters the citric acid cycle.
concepts.name: Acetyl-CoA

concepts.description: An electron carrier molecule produced during the citric acid cycle, which donates electrons to the electron transport chain.
concepts.name: FADH2
